report.summary: All four UI tests fail on the same cause: the app's /books page sometimes takes up to 8 seconds to render, because list_books sleeps for a random 0–8 s (app/main.py:150). The UI fixture caps every action at 5 s (tests/ui/conftest.py:7), so tests that load /books or wait for the post-register redirect time out. First step: remove or fix that random sleep in the app, then rerun the UI suite to confirm the failures go away.

causes.title: list_books sleeps a random 0–8 s, so /books sometimes exceeds the 5 s UI timeout
causes.explanation: list_books() calls time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8)) before querying the database. Every render of /books (render_books at app/main.py:256) and GET /api/books goes through it, so the response time is random. The UI fixture sets a 5 s default timeout for every Playwright action (tests/ui/conftest.py:7). When the sleep draws more than about 5 s, page.goto('/books') times out. The three books tests fail on that goto before any of their own steps run. test_new_user_lands_on_empty_bookshelf gets through the form and the click succeeds, then times out while waiting for the redirect to /books to finish loading. The outcome depends on chance, so the same commit can pass on a rerun. The application is slow only sometimes, which makes these tests flaky, not product bugs.
evidence: app/main.py:149-150: def list_books(user_id: int) -> list[dict]: / time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8))
tests/ui/conftest.py:6-7: """Nothing in this app should take longer than 5 s...""" / page.set_default_timeout(5000)
test_added_book_is_listed: Page.goto: Timeout 5000ms exceeded. Call log: navigating to "http://127.0.0.1:63061/books", waiting until "load"
test_book_created_through_api_shows_in_ui: Page.goto: Timeout 5000ms exceeded. navigating to "http://127.0.0.1:63060/books", waiting until "load"
test_future_year_shows_error_and_keeps_input: Page.goto: Timeout 5000ms exceeded. navigating to "http://127.0.0.1:63061/books", waiting until "load"

test_new_user_lands_on_empty_bookshelf: Locator.click: Timeout 5000ms exceeded. ... click action done / waiting for scheduled navigations to finish (page url /register; submit button was clicked successfully)
tests/ui/test_login_ui.py:9: AuthPage(page).open_register().submit(...) fails at the submit click, and the post-submit redirect to /books is the slow step
causes.suggested_fix: Remove the random sleep from list_books in app/main.py:150. If it was meant to simulate a slow backend, make the delay opt-in and off by default (for example, behind an env var that only a dedicated slow-path test sets) so the UI suite never hits it. Then rerun the UI suite several times to confirm the timeouts are gone. Do not raise the 5 s timeout to hide the problem, because the sleep can exceed any fixed limit.
